specializations.description: +20% PvE Damage Tolerance and +10 PvP Damage Tolerance to Earth Spirit
10% chance to activate skill when Earth Spirit lands attack
5% chance to restore 5% of Spirit HP when landing Earth Spirit attack

levels.description:
Summons an Earth Spirit.
The Earth Spirit uses a skill that deals <chat_combat>[[damage:min:247:135:1:1]]-[[damage:max:247:135:1:1]]</> Earth damage to a target within 20m and increases Enmity by <chat_combat>3750</>. Has a 30% chance to inflict Taunt for 2s if the target is a player.
The Earth Spirit fights alongside the caster using basic attacks, with a 10% chance to use its skill and increasing Enmity each time an attack lands. It is dismissed upon selecting the summon icon.
Each skill level increases the Earth Spirit's Defense and HP by 2%.

The Earth Spirit uses a skill that deals <chat_combat>[[damage:min:2790:135:1:1]]-[[damage:max:2790:135:1:1]]</> Earth damage to a target within 20m and increases Enmity by <chat_combat>3750</>. Has a 30% chance to inflict Taunt for 2s if the target is a player.
The Earth Spirit fights alongside the caster using basic attacks, with a 10% chance to use its skill and increasing Enmity each time an attack lands. It is dismissed upon selecting the summon icon.
Each skill level increases the Earth Spirit's Defense and HP by 2%.

7 Stagger Gauge Damage
Spirit Skill Cooldown: 3s
